advantage.best_effort_shed_explanation: PulseFlow intentionally sacrifices low-priority telemetry (Clicks, Page Views, Logs) under resource overload in order to protect revenue-critical transactions (Orders, Payments), guaranteeing zero silent drops and deterministic low latency.
